quote // The source stays as written, inside the bold lead where the reader sees it;

Because (Claude, not asked): a person reads "Because (measured):" exactly as before, and an agent finds itemprop="source" holding "measured." Only a reason's leading **Because (…):** or **Answer (…):** counts. All 30 in mock-control at f02528f are marked.

Chose: Times are shown in UTC, and say so

where src/render.ts file page

quote return `${date}, added in <data itemprop="added" value="${plan.added.sha}"><code>${esc(plan.added.short)}</code></data> <time datetime="${at}">${at.slice(11, 16)} UTC</time>`;

Because (Claude, not asked): the page is static and can't know the reader's timezone. The commit's time is what orders plans that share a date, so it's shown with its zone rather than in a guessed local one. Vellum is 17:23 UTC, which is 13:23 in Jeff's own timezone.
